notes.title: Alpha V2 News:
notes.notes:
Hello Strangers,

Less than a week has passed since the launch of Strange Space Alpha 1 and we already are hard at work preparing the release of Alpha 2.  We have about 1 and a half levels complete and we intend to launch the next version update with 2 complete levels. 

Some features we hope to include in the next version will be 2 new language translations, Spanish and German, some new items in the sandbox mode, and new trophies.

We still need to wrap up the next chapters of the story as well as get the voice acting in place. The music and sound effects need to be implemented as well as the trophies. 

We're excited about V2 and hope you are as well. More updates to come.

Thank you!

-Adam
